verdict.rationale: Lorikeet says it connects to your knowledge base to 'seamlessly ingest data', which suggests connector-based ingestion rather than manual uploads. It can also audit the knowledge base for outdated articles. Neither item says sources are re-synced on a schedule or when content changes. Missing for 10: documented scheduled or change-triggered re-sync, sync frequency/latency details, sync status or monitoring, independent corroboration.
